## Zhuangzi on freedom

Zhuangzi (c. 369–c. 286 BCE) approaches freedom within Daoism. Knowledge claims are relative to standpoint; the famous butterfly dream questions sharp self–other boundaries. “Free and easy wandering” (xiaoyao) names a skillful ease that follows transformation rather than forcing one measure on all things. On this page, the archive isolates English passages where that project meets freedom most directly—useful for searches such as “zhuangzi quotes on freedom.”
